newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended stable against its U.S. counterpart in modest trade on Tuesday due to the lack of market-inspiring factors, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.667 against Monday's T$27.670, off an intra-day high of T$27.665.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$183 million.
"The Japanese market closed for holiday on Tuesday, resulting in a quiet market in the rest of Asia," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said demand for both Taiwan and U.S. currencies was relatively balanced in the absence of market-moving factors.
They expected the Taiwan dollar to reflect the strong U.S. dollar overseas and go lower in the near term.
A T$27.64-69 range was seen for Wednesday.
